event_summary: A stacked set of colored rectangular blocks is disturbed, and the yellow and blue blocks tip and fall to the right while the red block remains upright.
raw_event_description: At the start, a red rectangular block stands upright on a tabletop, a yellow rectangular block lies horizontally across its top, and a blue rectangular block stands vertically on the right side of the yellow block with orange-and-black curved gripper parts above it. The arrangement stays still for a short interval. Then the blue block and yellow block move away from the stacked arrangement, tipping and falling toward the right side of the table. The red block stays upright. The yellow block and blue block come to rest separated on the tabletop to the right of the red block, with the orange-and-black gripper parts still partly visible near the top of the frame.

reasons: The red, yellow, and blue blocks are visible in a stacked arrangement before the motion begins.
The orange-and-black gripper parts are partially visible at the top edge.
The tabletop and background are visible.
